resources.string: Replace the default clock and date with the geometric digital clock. Turn off to restore your Wallpaper & style clock. Lyrics keep their own space below.
Keep the ambient clock visible while the phone is idle. Turn off to use brief tap, lift and Motion Sense checks instead.
Show charging styles during brief tap, lift and Motion Sense checks when Always-on display is off. Plugging in requests one normal ambient pulse; it does not keep AOD on.
Play once when a charger is connected, then show the selected charging information. Respects reduced animation and pocket detection.
Detailed · clock, meter and live readings
Minimal · dim percentage and charging label

Detailed shows a magenta charging meter, temperature, voltage, time estimate and battery-side power. Minimal uses dim text on black. Both reserve space for lyrics and move with AOD burn-in protection. Unavailable readings show a dash; the percentage reflects device-reported precision.
Show the selected charging style while Always-on display is enabled. Takes precedence over the ambient-display switch during AOD.
